title: You Think Focus Follows Your Gaze, Yet Your Brain Aims Attention Before Eyes Move
description:
You think sharp focus always follows your physical gaze! Yet an invisible beam scouts ahead before gaze moves! This is the true story of Michael Posner's Attention Spotlight. Here is what went wrong with old vision myths.
